== Trivia ==
* An [[w:Unguent|unguent]] is a soothing topical preparation spread on wounds, burns, rashes, abrasions or other topical injuries.
* This skill references lore that [[w:Troll|trolls]] have regenerative properties.
* [[Sugar Jolt (long)]] has the same visual effect.
